evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: This describes one feature (creating a game with optional description); the fields are attributes of that single feature, not separate independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting estimators via a URL; not combining multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a round by entering an item; the input detail is an attribute of the feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing all items for the session; the example question in 'so that' explains the benefit, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item (for estimation or re-estimation) is one feature; 're-estimated' is a use-case of the same action.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item; the justification explains need, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: editing an item; not combining independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting an item; atomic as stated.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability to show estimates early; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accepting the average as agreed estimate; atomic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: auto-fill estimate under a specific condition; condition is an acceptance criterion, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: entering the agreed estimate; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: re-estimating a previously estimated story; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: importing stories; although similar to copy/paste (PP-015), this single story is atomic.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: copy/paste stories; an alternative import mechanism but individually atomic.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: browsing previous games; not combining multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the transcript; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: HTML export; although there is also CSV export (PP-019), this story is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: CSV export; atomic and distinct from PP-018 but not combined within this story.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deleting a game and its associated stored data; one implementable action.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account creation; listing required fields are attributes of the feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: logging in; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: updating account details; broad but still one implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: account deletion and removal of data; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: presenting dates/times in user's local timezone; not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: password reminder via email; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting the estimation scale; listing two options is an exclusive choice, not multiple independent features in one story.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: inviting with an upper limit; the limit is an attribute, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: joining a game via provided URL; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the current item being estimated; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing the list of items for the session; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: immediate visibility of who has submitted an estimate; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: simultaneous reveal of estimates after all have voted; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability to change estimate until reveal; one implementable behavior.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing prior estimates per estimator for the current story; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: visibility of who gave which estimates in the current round; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: starting a shared two-minute timer; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic timer reset on condition; condition is part of the feature, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: scrolling history of prior rounds; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: consistent card ordering; one implementable requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ability to change estimate before draw completion; atomic (similar to PP-034 but not combined).

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: display a thumbnail photo near played cards; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: standards compliance; although it references multiple standards, it's one cross-cutting quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: glossary/definitions list; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: creating database indexes as a task to improve performance; while it may involve multiple indexes, the story expresses one implementable improvement feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: cross-browser compatibility across listed browsers; the list is part of the acceptance scope, not multiple separate stories in one.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: accessibility compliance; atomic as a single quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: responsiveness/performance expectation; one cohesive requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: Unicode support; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: sensible/predictable URLs; one implementable requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: friendly error pages; atomic.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: anonymized storage of results; atomic requirement regarding data handling.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing usage metrics; the scope is a single feature request.
